opening.title: Opening stock
opening.invalidDates: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.

opening.previewErrors: {{count}} error(s) found. Fix them and preview again.
opening.replayed: This batch was already submitted; it was not posted twice.

tracking.duplicate: Lot or serial numbers must be unique.
tracking.dateOrder: Expiry date cannot precede manufacture date.

trace.title: Lot and serial trace

receipt.invalid: Enter a date and at least one valid line. Quantity and unit cost allow up to six decimal places.

issue.title: Other issues
issue.invalid: Enter a date and at least one valid line. Quantity and estimated unit cost allow up to six decimal places.

stocktake.scopeHint: Select one or more warehouses. Categories and items are optional filters; selected categories include their children.
stocktake.categoryPermission: You cannot view item categories. You can still create a stocktake by warehouse or item.
stocktake.noCategories: No item categories are available. You can create a stocktake by warehouse or item.

stocktake.recount: Book quantity changed. Recount this line before submitting.
stocktake.staleKeys: Stock moved after this snapshot. Review these keys and refresh the snapshot.

stocktake.invalidCount: Check each found line and enter nonnegative quantities with up to six decimal places.
stocktake.missing: Every line and lot or serial number must be counted before submission.

assembly.title: Product assembly
assembly.invalidItemId: Finished item ID must be a positive whole number.

validation.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be positive, below 10^13, and have at most six decimal places.
validation.finishedComponentConflict: A finished item cannot also be a component.
validation.trackingLimit: An assembly can have at most 10000 tracking entries.
validation.serialUnique: A serial number cannot repeat for the same item in one assembly.
validation.trackingRequired: Enter a lot or serial number.
validation.trackingKindRequired: Enter either a lot or serial number for each entry.
validation.serialQuantity: Each serial number represents exactly one base unit.
validation.lotDatesOnly: Manufacture and expiry dates apply only to received lots.
validation.expiryOrder: Expiry date cannot precede manufacture date.
validation.trackingKindMixed: Do not mix lot and serial numbers on one row.
validation.trackingUnique: Lot or serial numbers must be unique within a row.
validation.notTracked: This item is not lot or serial tracked.
validation.useLots: This item uses lot tracking. Enter lot numbers.
validation.useSerials: This item uses serial tracking. Enter serial numbers.
validation.serialWhole: Serial-tracked quantity must be a whole number.

assembly.maxComponents: At most 999 component lines are allowed.
assembly.loadFailed: Could not load assemblies. Try searching again.
assembly.invalidDates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
assembly.invalid: Enter a date, one finished item and at least one distinct component. Item and warehouse are required; quantity must be positive with at most six decimal places.
assembly.hint: Saving a draft does not change stock. Lot and serial numbers may be added later, but must be complete before submission. Finished cost is calculated from component values on approval.

transfer.title: Inventory transfers
transfer.invalid: Enter a date and at least one valid line: item and both warehouses are required; quantity must be above 0 with up to six decimal places.
transfer.sameKey: The source and destination warehouse and location must not be identical.
transfer.invalidDates: The end date must not be earlier than the start date.
transfer.hint: Enter quantities in the item's base unit. Lot and serial numbers are taken from the source and moved unchanged; drafts may omit them, but they are required before submitting.
